headline: Canadian Stocks Edge Higher As Optimism Rises Ahead Of U.S.-Iran Peace Talks
summary: Canadian stocks inched higher on Friday as expectations of an end to the Gulf crisis grew ahead of U.S.-Iran talks scheduled for the following day.
why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark and is heavily weighted toward energy and materials, so Gulf-related developments affect it directly.
why_moved: Investors reacted to expectations that U.S.-Iran talks could end the Gulf crisis. Easing geopolitical tension tends to lift risk-sensitive equities.
